name: back kick overhead press
description: A dynamic combo of a backward leg kick with an overhead arm press. It works the shoulders and glutes together and raises your heart rate.
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your hands at shoulder height.
Press both hands straight overhead as you kick one leg back.
Squeeze the glute at the top without arching your lower back.
Bring the hands and foot back to the start.
Switch legs and repeat at a lively pace.
